newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ZALAKERAMIA FIRMS AFTER Q1 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: ZALAKERAMIA FIRMS AFTER Q1 EARNINGS.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia traded firmer on Tuesday following the release of its first quarter earnings, traders said.
Zalakeramia opened at 7,140 forints and at 1015 GMT it stood at 7,150, up from Monday's close of 7,075.
"Buyers appeared on Zalakeramia's market after its capital increase and the first quarter figures reinforced these buyings," one trader said.
The stock had one seller while there were various investors who showed stronger demand at 7,150 forints, he said.
Tuesday morning Zalakeramia reported an IAS net profit of 144.2 million forints for the first three months of 1997, up from a net profit of 105.4 million in January-March 1996.
The company raised its 1.836 billion forints issued share capital by 1.04 billion forints earlier this month via a private placement to finance acquisitions and expansion plans.
